articles.description: As the Phillies' representative in the players' union, Garrett Stubbs is on the front lines of baseball's upcoming labor dispute. He joined "Phillies Extra" to discuss the CBA and the next season.
articles.title: Phillies Extra: Garrett Stubbs on baseball’s looming labor fight, the case against a salary cap, and more

articles.description: Lefty reliever Tim Mayza talks to the Inquirer's Scott Lauber on his new contract, pitching for the team he grew up watching, and more.
articles.title: Phillies Extra: Lefty reliever Tim Mayza on his new contract, pitching for the team he grew up watching, and more

articles.description: The Phillies had three catchers on their playoff roster, but don’t mistake that for depth at the position. Once again, they must find help — and possibly an eventual successor — for J.T. Realmuto.
articles.title: Phillies 2027 catchers outlook: Free-agent options, prospect forecast, and more
